name: fusion_producer_consumer
description: Fuse producer-consumer linalg operations to eliminate intermediate tensor materialization and improve cache locality.

parameters.name: producer_tag
parameters.description: Tag name of the producer operation (e.g., 'conv', 'matmul'). If empty, auto-detect first linalg operation.

parameters.name: consumer_tag
parameters.description: Tag name of the consumer operation. If empty, auto-detect operation consuming producer's output.

parameters.name: fusion_strategy
parameters.description: Fusion strategy: 'auto' (let MLIR decide), 'loop' (fuse into loops), 'producer' (fuse into producer).
